## Projects

### 1. PGP Encrypted Chat App
- URL: https://sagarhutagi.tech/project/encrypted-chat
- Code: https://github.com/sagarhutagi/tor-chat-web
- Description: An end-to-end encrypted messaging application operating over Tor hidden services with client-side PGP encryption.
- Key Technical Details:
  - Hosted locally as a Tor hidden service with a custom vanity v3 .onion address generated using mkp224o (sagarh prefix).
  - Client-side encryption via OpenPGP.js ensures messages are encrypted before transmission; private keys never leave local storage.
  - Supabase backend with Row-Level Security handles real-time ciphertext routing and public key distribution without metadata retention.

### 2. Black Hole
- URL: https://sagarhutagi.tech/project/black-hole
- Code: https://github.com/sagarhutagi/blackhole
- Description: An anonymous real-time campus discussion platform with ephemeral posts and daily purges.
- Key Technical Details:
  - Real-time updates, presence indicators, and emoji reactions powered by Supabase Realtime and PostgreSQL.
  - Generates randomized anonymous handles per session to center discussion around content.
  - Daily purge routine permanently deletes inactive posts at midnight IST for privacy and ephemerality.
  - Built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

### 3. AI Code Doctor
- URL: https://sagarhutagi.tech/project/ai-code-doctor
- Code: https://github.com/sagarhutagi/ai-code-doctor
- Description: A local-first code analysis and diagnostic tool running open-weights models on-device without cloud APIs.
- Key Technical Details:
  - Uses Ollama for on-device inference, ensuring sensitive source code remains private and offline-capable.
  - FastAPI backend interfaces with local LLMs, handling prompt pipelines and code linting diagnostics.
  - Clean web interface for submitting snippets and reviewing optimization recommendations.

### 4. PESU Helper
- URL: https://sagarhutagi.tech/project/pesu-helper
- Code: https://github.com/sagarhutagi/pesu-helper-extension
- Description: A browser extension enhancing the PESU Academy student portal with automated PDF organization and study tracking.
- Key Technical Details:
  - Injects native PDF viewer controls directly into the university portal iframe for one-click downloading and tab viewing.
  - Automatically names downloaded course files according to specific lecture topics and course units.
  - Tracks active study time across lecture materials with daily reset logs and course unit syllabus filters.

### 5. Smart Ship
- URL: https://sagarhutagi.tech/project/smart-ship
- Demo: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1BZz6glL9o3w-IC6s5pwm-dUTCaBAwCi-/view
- Description: An electric marine vessel prototype designed to eliminate maritime collisions and emissions using automated sensor systems.
- Key Technical Details:
  - 100% electric propulsion with high-efficiency onboard solar panels capable of charging the battery bank within an hour.
  - Ultrasonic sensor array scans for obstacles and immediately cuts propulsion to prevent collisions.
  - Moisture-sensing bilge pump automatically triggers when water ingress is detected.
  - Autonomous LDR ambient lighting switches navigation lights on at dusk and off at dawn.
  - Functional electromechanical steering mechanism linked to helm inputs.

### 6. 9 Lives
- URL: https://sagarhutagi.tech/project/9-lives
- Description: A 2D puzzle-platformer built in 48 hours for the Delta Time game jam, centered around the theme "Death is not the end."
- Key Technical Details:
  - Built for Delta Time Game Jam at PES University EC Campus.
  - Death acts as a progression mechanic: sacrificing lives unlocks environmental modifiers (gravity alterations, enhanced vision) to bypass obstacles.
  - Won 1st place in Art and 3rd place overall.

### 7. Notes App
- URL: https://sagarhutagi.tech/project/notes-app
- Description: A subject-categorized study notes publishing platform for sharing Obsidian-authored notes as PDFs with collaborative discussion threads.
- Key Technical Details:
  - Notes authored locally in Obsidian with Markdown and LaTeX formatting, then published as uniform PDFs.
  - Course-level subject categorization for systematic syllabus tracking.
  - Built-in PDF reader with an interactive comment and discussion section at the bottom of each document for student collaboration.

## Writing & Articles

### My First FOSS Event: IndiaFOSS ‘26
- URL: https://sagarhutagi.tech/blog/my-first-foss-event-indiafoss-26
- Medium: https://medium.com/@sagarmh6364/my-first-foss-event-indiafoss-26-1271809c0335
- Published: October 2, 2026
- Summary: A personal account and reflection on attending IndiaFOSS '26 at NIMHANS Convention Centre in Bengaluru. Covers open-source hardware demonstrations (ChipWhisperer AES key extraction, custom stream decks, Flipper Zero), meeting Kailash Nadh (CTO of Zerodha), and networking with the broader FOSS community.
